## Pro bono statistical consulting opportunities

The Statistical Science Majors Union (SSMU) has started a statistical consulting branch called DSCI. Check out these links if you're interested in getting involved:

- **interest form to stay updated**: <http://tinyurl.com/dsci-interest>;
- **learn about the fall projects**: <http://tinyurl.com/dsci-projects>;
- **preview application questions**: <http://tinyurl.com/dsci-project-qs>;
- **apply ideally by Thursday 9/10, at latest by the weekend**: <http://tinyurl.com/dsci-projects-apply>.
